clue.text: Irascible type to go over plot

parts.note: to cross is to go over, as with a road or bridge
a patch is a small plot of ground

explanation.surface: A bad-tempered person is told to walk across a piece of land.
explanation.definitionFit: A crosspatch is a grumpy, easily irritated person, a synonym for a bad-tempered sort.

clue.text: Was sorry one sounded abrupt

indicators.note: sounded means a word is said aloud and a like-sounding spelling taken

parts.note: rude means abrupt or curt

explanation.surface: Someone regretted being curt when they spoke.
explanation.definitionFit: Regretted, felt remorse over.

clue.text: Make miserable by bringing up northern sagas

indicators.note: bringing up in a down clue means the letters run upwards, reversing them

parts.note: the Eddas are the Old Norse saga collections

explanation.surface: Being forced to read Norse epics gets you down.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bringing up' reverses NEDDAS; 'by' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To sadden is to cause sorrow or unhappiness.

clue.text: Gift dispatched in advance?

indicators.note: in advance supplies a prefix meaning before, placed ahead

parts.note: sent means dispatched
sent means dispatched

explanation.surface: A gift posted ahead of time.
explanation.definitionFit: A plain synonym: something handed over freely as a token of goodwill, the surface's 'sent ahead' pointing at the parcel.

clue.text: Old communist leader had bird round

parts.note: a tit is a small songbird
a round shape is like the letter O

explanation.surface: A veteran Red politician kept a bird nearby.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Had' is a link word. Tito led communist Yugoslavia.
explanation.definitionFit: Josip Broz Tito was the Yugoslav communist president.

clue.text: Fruits not quite hard on top

indicators.note: not quite means the word hard loses its final letter

parts.note: a vest is an upper-body garment, a top

explanation.surface: Produce that is still slightly firm on its upper side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' puts the top after the trimmed word in a down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: The harvest is the crop gathered in, the fruits of the land.

clue.text: Terribly nice, if able to be helpful

indicators.note: terribly suggests something badly messed up, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Being awfully pleasant if one can is a good thing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Terribly' rearranges NICE IF ABLE; 'to be' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Beneficial means advantageous or doing good.

clue.text: Profitless sale-see dollars slipping away

indicators.note: slipping away suggests things sliding out of place, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Cash seeps out when goods are sold at a loss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sale' belongs to the definition; 'slipping away' rearranges SEE DOLLARS.
explanation.definitionFit: A loss leader is an item sold below cost to lure shoppers in.

clue.text: Suitable person for girl to love?

definitions.text: Suitable person for girl to love?

parts.note: her is the pronoun standing for a girl
love is nil in tennis scoring, shaped like the letter O

explanation.surface: A question about which sort of man a girl should fall for.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue is both definition and wordplay: a girl's ideal man is a figure to look up to, and 'for' and 'to' simply join HER and O.
explanation.definitionFit: A romantic idol or admired champion is just the kind of man a girl might adore.

clue.text: Ancient law applies exactly to tenant

parts.note: dead means exactly, as in dead right or dead centre
a letter is one who lets property out to a tenant

explanation.surface: An old statute is said to bind a renter precisely.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Applies' is a link word; the second piece is a landlord seen as one who lets to a tenant.
explanation.definitionFit: A rule still on the statute book but long unenforced, an obsolete regulation.

clue.text: Virginia hires out servants

parts.note: VA is the abbreviation for the US state of Virginia
to let is to hire out, as with a room or flat

explanation.surface: A woman named Virginia runs a domestic staffing agency.
explanation.definitionFit: Valets are personal manservants who attend to a gentleman's clothes.

clue.text: Being successful is attractive

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both gaining victory and engagingly charming, as in a winning manner.

clue.text: Say, elder on ship faces the axe in his job

definitions.text: faces the axe in his job

parts.note: elder is a kind of wood, 'say' marking it as an example
a cutter is a small sailing ship

explanation.surface: An old man aboard a vessel is threatened with the sack.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On' is a link; the surface threatens a dismissal, but the definition is someone wielding an axe at work.
explanation.definitionFit: A lumberjack spends his working day confronting trees with his axe.

clue.text: It opens a Brazil ballet

definitions.meaning: a Brazil is a Brazil nut, cracked open by a tool

explanation.definitionFit: The tool cracks nutshells such as a Brazil's, and is also Tchaikovsky's famous ballet.

clue.text: Roof wall becomes black in storm

indicators.note: in places the letter for black inside the word for storm

parts.note: a gale is a storm
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils

explanation.surface: Part of a house turns dark in bad weather.
explanation.definitionFit: The triangular end wall under a pitched roof.

clue.text: Attribute article to writer

parts.note: a is the indefinite article
a scribe is a writer or copyist

explanation.surface: A piece of journalism is credited to its author.
explanation.definitionFit: To attribute something is to credit or assign it to a source.

clue.text: Enrage by losing head in peril

indicators.note: losing head means the first letter is removed from the synonym

parts.note: danger means peril

explanation.surface: Being decapitated in a dangerous moment would infuriate anyone.
explanation.walkthrough: 'By' is a link; 'losing head' removes the D.
explanation.definitionFit: To anger is to infuriate or provoke.

clue.text: It isn't common to get a bad mark

definitions.meaning: a dialect or colloquial contraction of 'it is not', common meaning vulgar or uneducated speech

explanation.definitionFit: The word is both a slangy contraction meaning 'it is not' and a stain or blemish.

clue.text: Vow to make a hot stew

indicators.note: to stew is to cook and mix up, so these letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: A promise to prepare a warm casserole.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stew' rearranges A and HOT; 'to make' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A vow is a solemn promise or sworn pledge.

clue.text: Daughter follows to succeed in turn

indicators.note: follows places the daughter's letter after the other piece

parts.note: to win is to succeed

explanation.surface: A daughter takes over from her parent when her turn comes.
explanation.definitionFit: To wind is to turn, as when coiling a rope or a clock key.

clue.text: All the company's cars are fast

definitions.meaning: the vehicles owned by a business collectively

explanation.definitionFit: A firm's motor pool is its vehicle stock, and as an adjective the word means swift.

clue.text: Appear nervous, having bet

explanation.walkthrough: A flutter is British slang for a modest bet, as on a horse race.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both to quiver with nerves and, in British slang, a small wager.

clue.text: Caterer moves into row of houses

indicators.note: moves indicates that the letters shift into a new order

explanation.surface: A caterer relocates to a street of houses.
explanation.definitionFit: A terrace is a row of joined houses, common in Britain.

clue.text: In which one might trow about prophecy

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about
an oracle is a prophecy or the one who gives it

explanation.surface: A seer muses on what a man might believe.
explanation.walkthrough: The printed 'trow' is a misread of 'row': the definition is a small boat one paddles.
explanation.definitionFit: A small round wicker boat traditionally paddled on Welsh rivers.

clue.text: Artillery gun returned to soldier

indicators.note: returned means the two pieces are read backwards as one run

parts.note: RA is the Royal Artillery
a Luger is a German pistol

explanation.surface: A field gun is sent back to the infantryman who owns it.
explanation.definitionFit: A regular is a professional soldier in a standing army, as opposed to a reservist.

clue.text: Disquiet as peacekeepers relax

parts.note: UN is the United Nations, whose troops keep the peace
to rest is to relax

explanation.surface: Tension rises as international troops take time off.
explanation.definitionFit: Unrest is agitation or disturbance.

clue.text: Card of admission to collect kit, etc.

indicators.note: collect suggests gathering things up in a heap, so these letters are reassembled

explanation.surface: A pass lets you pick up your gear and the rest.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Collect' rearranges KIT and ETC; 'to' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A ticket is a printed pass granting entry to an event.

clue.text: Contribution from Maria Callas?

indicators.note: contribution from means part of the following words supplies the letters

explanation.surface: A question about what the great soprano offered.
explanation.walkthrough: Maria Callas was a famous opera soprano, so the solo she sings is also the whole clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A solo song in an opera, such as a soprano would perform.

clue.text: Grass stalk is curved

definitions.meaning: a stiff grass or its stem

explanation.definitionFit: The word names a type of stiff grass stem and also means not straight.

clue.text: In three diamonds, holding a ten was a menace

indicators.note: holding means the first group contains the second

parts.note: taken as the word three
taken as the word ten
D is the card-game abbreviation for diamonds

explanation.surface: A bridge player bidding three diamonds with a ten in hand posed a danger.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a bridge auction, but 'holding' is the container signal, not a hand of cards; diamonds is just the letter D.
explanation.definitionFit: To have menaced is to have posed a danger or intimidated.

clue.text: Observe what was half conveyed

definitions.note: a present-tense verb, while the answer is past tense; 'what was' links it

indicators.note: half signals taking the back half of the letters of conveyed

explanation.surface: Notice what was only partly communicated.
explanation.definitionFit: To watch or look at closely, past tense here.

clue.text: The proper condition of land?

parts.note: real means genuine or proper
estate is an old word for state or condition

explanation.surface: A question about the true state of a piece of ground.
explanation.definitionFit: Real estate is property in buildings and ground, the legal term for land.
